setup: Copy evals/fixtures/repo to a temporary folder, run `git init`, commit everything on `main`, and start the session there. The repo uses a local markdown tracker, so no GitLab or GitHub access is needed.

evals.name: linear-chain-runs-in-order
evals.expected_output: Three waves (01, then 02, then 03), each ticket merged and closed before the next one starts. NOTES.md ends with alpha, beta, gamma in that order.
expectations: The printed dependency map has the edges 01 -> 02 and 02 -> 03 and three waves of one ticket each
Ticket 02 is dispatched only after ticket 01 shows a verified merge on main and Status: closed
Each ticket gets its own worktree, and every merge happens in the integration worktree
Each worker loads references/worker-brief.md and each integrator loads references/integrator-brief.md, by absolute path
Each worker reports `review: skipped` because only a doc file changed
main has three --no-ff merge commits, each with the ticket number in its message
NOTES.md ends with the lines alpha, beta, gamma in that order
The spec stays open, and the run ends with a hand-off note on the spec and a one-sentence /clear suggestion

evals.name: fan-in-runs-independent-tickets-in-parallel
evals.expected_output: Wave 1 holds 01 and 02, dispatched together; wave 2 holds 03. The second merge of wave 1 has a mechanical conflict on NOTES.md that the integrator resolves by keeping both lines.
expectations: The printed dependency map has the edges 01 -> 03 and 02 -> 03, with 01 and 02 in wave 1 and 03 in wave 2
The workers for 01 and 02 are spawned in the same turn
Merges happen one at a time, 01 before 02
The NOTES.md conflict is resolved by keeping both red and blue, not by aborting the merge
Ticket 03 is dispatched from the integrated HEAD that contains both earlier merges
NOTES.md contains red and blue, and purple after both

evals.name: backlink-without-parent-is-excluded
evals.expected_output: Only ticket 01 is implemented. Ticket 02 appears under excluded references, because it mentions the spec but declares no parent.
expectations: The graph lists 02-research.md under excluded references, with the reason that it has no ## Parent section
No worker, worktree or branch is created for ticket 02
Ticket 02 keeps Status: open and NOTES.md has no line added for it
Ticket 01 is merged and closed, and NOTES.md contains the line one
